package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgconn"
)

type hybridRecordedStatement struct {
	sql  string
	args []any
}
type hybridRecordingTx struct {
	pgx.Tx
	statements []hybridRecordedStatement
}

func (t *hybridRecordingTx) Exec(_ context.Context, sql string, args ...any) (pgconn.CommandTag, error) {
	t.statements = append(t.statements, hybridRecordedStatement{sql, args})
	return pgconn.NewCommandTag("UPDATE 1"), nil
}

func TestHybridTargetedPersistenceRejectsProtectedRewrite(t *testing.T) {
	current := domain.StudentLearningPath{ID: "path", StudentID: "student", Version: 1, Items: []domain.LearningPathItem{{ID: "current", Status: domain.LearningPathItemReady, Position: 0}, {ID: "future", Status: domain.LearningPathItemPlanned, Position: 1}}}
	desired := current
	desired.Version++
	desired.Items = append([]domain.LearningPathItem{}, current.Items...)
	desired.Items[0].Status = domain.LearningPathItemSkippedMastered
	tx := &hybridRecordingTx{}
	if err := persistHybridFuturePath(context.Background(), tx, current, desired, ""); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrHybridUnsafe) {
		t.Fatalf("protected row rewrite accepted: %v", err)
	}
	if len(tx.statements) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("protected guard ran after SQL mutation")
	}
}

func TestHybridTargetedPersistenceKeepsProtectedRowsAndUsesPositivePermutation(t *testing.T) {
	current := domain.StudentLearningPath{ID: "path", StudentID: "student", Version: 1, Items: []domain.LearningPathItem{{ID: "current", Status: domain.LearningPathItemReady, Position: 0}, {ID: "future-a", Status: domain.LearningPathItemPlanned, Position: 1}, {ID: "future-b", Status: domain.LearningPathItemPlanned, Position: 2}}}
	desired := current
	desired.Version++
	desired.Items = append([]domain.LearningPathItem{}, current.Items...)
	desired.Items[1], desired.Items[2] = desired.Items[2], desired.Items[1]
	desired.Items[1].Position = 1
	desired.Items[2].Position = 2
	tx := &hybridRecordingTx{}
	if err := persistHybridFuturePath(context.Background(), tx, current, desired, ""); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	temporary := 0
	revision := 0
	for _, statement := range tx.statements {
		if strings.Contains(statement.sql, "DELETE") {
			t.Fatal("targeted writer deleted owner rows")
		}
		if strings.Contains(statement.sql, "UPDATE student_learning_path_item") {
			if statement.args[1] == "current" {
				t.Fatal("targeted writer touched protected current occurrence")
			}
			if strings.Contains(statement.sql, "SET position=$3") {
				temporary++
				if statement.args[2].(int) <= 2 {
					t.Fatal("temporary position collides with existing path")
				}
			}
		}
		if strings.Contains(statement.sql, "INSERT INTO student_learning_path_revision") {
			revision++
		}
	}
	if temporary != 2 || revision != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("permutation=%d revisions=%d", temporary, revision)
	}
}
